headline: Huge row over diesel subsidy, hauliers furious at the government's decision
summary: Hungary's diesel subsidy package has drawn strong criticism from the haulage sector, which says the measure excludes operators hit hard by high diesel prices. Private diesel car owners under 150 horsepower receive a monthly subsidy.
why: Diesel costs are a major operating expense for road freight, so subsidy design affects transport firms, logistics margins and consumer prices.
